# Account ledger dependency notices

These are unmodified license and author notices from the Go modules linked by
the management binary on Linux and Windows. Module names are represented by
directory names with `/` replaced by `_`; exact versions and checksums are in
the repository's `go.mod` and `go.sum`. The existing YAML notices remain in
`third_party/yaml/`.

The separate development-only managed-core executable is built from source
with the pinned SagerNet dependencies; it is not yet installed or included as
a runtime binary by the program release/upgrade workflow. Its upstream source
and license are recorded in the root NOTICE.md.
